# M&A Target Screen Playbook — Day 2 Smoke

When advising on a payments-vertical target screen, the partner-led
checklist is to confirm three things before the next-step gate:
1. The deal thesis can be stated in one sentence (without filler).
2. The size band fits the firm's mandate (£100m–£500m EV, growth-stage).
3. The buyer's strategic rationale is concrete, not "synergies".

## Sourcing

Sources of opportunities: PE deal-flow trackers, sector consolidations,
distressed processes. Bias toward UK / Europe due to the firm's presence
and the auditor relationships already in place. Avoid US-only fintechs
unless the buyer has a US tax strategy already in motion.

## Diligence

Default to a 4-week diligence window with a 90-minute kickoff that
includes the audit lead. The kickoff sets the no-go criteria explicitly
so the team can kill the deal at the 2-week midpoint without ego.
